list.title: Orders
list.exportTruncatedBody: More orders match these filters. Narrow them to export the rest.
list.emptyBody: Orders placed by your customers will appear here once you start accepting payments. Pick a plan to unlock checkout.
list.noMatchingBody: Try clearing filters or searching by a different tracking number.

edit.evenExchange: Even exchange — no change to the order’s total amount.
edit.title: Edit Order #{number}
edit.description: Adjust line items, change quantities, or update shipping fee. Financial deltas and inventory levels update in real-time.
edit.empty: No items in this order. Add at least one item to continue.
edit.additionalChargeBody: The customer owes additional payment. Total balance will increase to {amount}.
edit.refundDueBody: The order total has decreased. This difference is available for customer refund.

settle.title: Mark this order as paid?
settle.description: Do this only once you have received {amount} for this order. Its payment status changes to Paid, and the dashboard has no action to undo it.
settle.failed: Could not mark the order as paid

placedVia.whatsapp_assistant: Placed on WhatsApp by your assistant
placedVia.telegram_assistant: Placed on Telegram by your assistant

statusActions.terminal: This order is {status} — no further transitions.

cancel.title: Cancel order {tracking}?
cancel.description: The order closes and cannot be reopened.
cancel.effectStock: Its items go back on sale, and any coupon or store credit it used is returned to the customer.
cancel.effectCustomer: The customer is told the order was cancelled.
cancel.cardPaid: This order was paid by card. Cancelling it would not return the payment — refund the order instead, which closes it.

itemsCard.title: Items
itemsCard.sheinNote: Shein availability and price can change after this order is placed.

fulfillmentCard.title: Fulfillment
fulfillmentCard.remaining: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} still to ship.
fulfillmentCard.remainingBlocked: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} still to ship — this order can no longer be fulfilled.
fulfillmentCard.allShipped: Every item on this order has shipped.
fulfillmentCard.shipped: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} shipped
fulfillmentCard.shippedCancelled: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} shipped (cancelled)

fulfillDialog.title: Fulfill items
fulfillDialog.description: Shipping these units moves them out of stock. Add tracking now, or leave it blank and ship without it.
fulfillDialog.submit: Fulfill {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

refunds.title: Refunds & cancellations
refunds.effectMoney: The money is returned to the customer through the original payment method.
refunds.effectBalance: Your shop balance is debited by the same amount.
refunds.effectRestock: Items marked for restock go back into inventory.
refunds.effectCoupon: Any coupon used on those items becomes usable again.

unappliedPayments.title: Payments not applied to this order

reason.paid_after_close: Paid after the order was closed

body.paid_after_close: The customer paid {amount} by card on {date}, after this order was closed. The payment was not applied, so the order stays closed.
body.amount_mismatch: The customer paid {amount} by card on {date}, but the order total is {total}. The payment was not applied and the order was not marked paid.
body.duplicate_charge: The customer paid {amount} by card on {date}, after this order had already been paid. Only the first payment was applied; this one is extra.
body.other: The customer paid {amount} by card on {date}. The payment was not applied to this order.

unappliedPayments.balanceNote: Your shop balance does not include these payments. If a customer disputes one with their bank instead, the amount is held from your balance.
unappliedPayments.closeFirst: Cancel the order first, then refund this payment.
unappliedPayments.confirmDescription: The money goes back to the card the customer paid with. This cannot be undone.
unappliedPayments.effectOrder: The order does not change: its status, total and items stay as they are.
unappliedPayments.effectBalance: Your shop balance is not affected.
unappliedPayments.effectCustomer: It may take a few business days to appear on the customer’s statement.

status.requested: Refund sent — waiting for the payment provider to confirm it.
status.pending: The refund of {amount} is on its way to the customer.

error.charge_disputed: the customer has disputed this payment with their bank, and it cannot be refunded while the dispute is open.
error.amount_too_large: part of this payment was already refunded outside the dashboard.
error.unconfirmed: The payment provider did not answer in time. Check again in a minute.
error.charge_already_refunded: the payment provider reports this payment as already refunded in full, but not from here. Nothing was sent; check whether the customer is still owed this amount before refunding again.
error.generic: the payment provider refused it. Try again later.

refusal.ORDER_STILL_OPEN: Cancel the order first, then refund this payment.
refusal.REFUND_IN_PROGRESS: A refund of this payment is being sent right now. Check again in a moment.
refusal.NOT_UNAPPLIED: This payment was applied to the order. Refund its items instead.
refusal.NO_PAYMENT_REFERENCE: The payment provider has no record of this payment, so it cannot be refunded here.
refusal.generic: The request did not complete. The card shows where the refund stands, and trying again never refunds twice.

unappliedPayments.loadFailed: Could not load the payments that were not applied to this order.

refundDialog.requestedBody: Approve it below to move the money.
refundDialog.title: Refund items
refundDialog.description: This creates a pending refund. No money moves until you approve it.
refundDialog.estimateNote: An estimate. The final amount is calculated when the refund is created — it carries each line's share of the order's discount and tax.
refundDialog.submit: Request refund for {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
refundDialog.restock: Restock these units when the refund is approved
